question: Can task-conditioned representations discover useful causal invariances not explicitly enumerated as cyclic-bit operators, and improve exact prediction on genuinely unfamiliar causal structures compared with fully trained equally informed controls under no additional oracle labels and complete CPU/RSS nonregression?
initial_gate: DK-0 analytic source-neutral information feasibility and adversarial witness BEFORE model authoring or prospective sample consumption

new_mechanism_hypothesis.candidate: Learn a soft causal-role/bit relational representation and parameter-sharing assignments from training trajectories only; infer candidate equivalences via predictive agreement and minimum conditional description length. No hardcoded cyclic operator class, predetermined group generators, supplied hidden family IDs or access to source laws.
new_mechanism_hypothesis.predeclared_bias: Generic relational compression/parameter tying is the allowed inductive bias; absolutely prior-free recognition is not identifiable for unrestricted causal functions.
new_mechanism_hypothesis.prohibited: Enumerating the specific hidden transformation as an oracle; generator imports; source-family conditional routing; reusing earlier fit/check/heldout; optimizing on prospective evaluation labels; added memory/compute or training information outside matched resource budget.

exact_information_contract.CHECK_role: veto-only, not training or hyperparameter selection
exact_information_contract.heldout_role: terminal evaluation only, no model selection
exact_information_contract.sourcefree_preflight_seeds: symbolic/analytic only; never instantiate 901–904 until frozen implementations and independent admission

primary_comparator: Independent fully trained task-conditioned relational predictor with matched input, supervision, parameters, optimization budget and full-process resource ceiling; neither candidate nor comparator receives hidden symmetry labels or oracle query privilege
strong_ceiling: Independent source-neutral exact/MDL structural search that sees identical observations; costs measured separately and interpreted as ceiling rather than disqualified weak control
baseline: Preserve F124-DI full-degree-four trained control where interface is applicable; mark genuinely out-of-class sources as ineligible rather than fabricating success

scoring.ablation: shuffle or erase learned relation assignments at equal dimensions, training budget and inference work; unique gain must vanish

source_only_initial_feasibility.hypothesis: For any non-exhaustive observed set, unrestricted Boolean causal tables admit at least two models agreeing on all FIT values, one globally bit-rotation-equivariant and another not.

qualification.workflow: exact parent SHA and tree identity -> frozen preregistration commit -> bounded analytic witness implementation -> cached focused tests where exact cache key applies -> one final system regression if build/acceptance attempted
qualification.engine: source-only analysis is not scientific experiment admission; CKB-plane sole orchestration and acceptance authority
